metadataRaw.title: How to SAFELY Pop Your Back With a Foam Roller
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to safely self pop, crack, or release (whatever you want to call it 🙂) your back using a foam roller.

The video will be broken up into separate parts with each one focusing on a different area of the back (i.e. upper and lower). 

Give each a try and let us know what worked best for you!

Link to foam roller: https://amzn.to/3tSbBc8

Chapters:
0:00 Intro
1:06 Upper Back (Horizontal)
4:18 Upper Back (Vertical)
6:55 Lower Back
8:47 Sacroiliac (SI) Joint
